definitions.gloss: eating until about 80 percent full; eating in moderation
definitions.explanation: The practice of stopping eating before feeling completely full, regarded as good for health. Also said as {腹八分目|はらはちぶんめ}.

examples.japanese: {腹八分|はらはちぶ}で{止|と}めておく。
{医者|いしゃ}に{腹八分|はらはちぶ}を{勧|すす}められた。
examples.english: The doctor advised me to eat in moderation.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}から「{腹八分|はらはちぶ}に{医者|いしゃ}いらず」と{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Since old times it has been said that eating to 80 percent keeps the doctor away.

notes:
Often expanded to {腹八分目|はらはちぶんめ}. Expresses the traditional idea that stopping before one is full is good for health and longevity.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {腹八分|はらはちぶ}に{医者|いしゃ}いらず: eating to 80 percent keeps the doctor away (proverb)
- {腹八分目|はらはちぶんめ}にする: to eat to about 80 percent full

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {満腹|まんぷく}: full stomach — the contrasting fully-fed state
